user.title: Huawei Home Storage
user.description: Choose how to sign in. Either way, the device IP, MAC, serial number and model are fetched from the cloud automatically.

account.title: Sign in to Huawei Account
account.description: Enter your Huawei account and password. Credentials are stored only in your Home Assistant instance and are used to discover the device.

authorize.title: Authorize Huawei Account

retry.title: Huawei Home Storage
retry.description: Could not reach Huawei Cloud. Check Home Assistant's network and press Submit to retry.

device.title: Select device
device.description: Choose the Home Storage device to add from your account.

menu.title: Account management
menu.description: {accounts} account(s) connected: {list}. Device attributes (disk, online, file space) come from the admin account; album stats differ per account.

add_account.title: Add Huawei account
add_account.description: Enter the Huawei account to connect to this storage. Each account sees its own albums and files.

remove_account.title: Remove account
remove_account.description: Pick an account to remove (at least one is kept). Its album entities are removed too.

relogin.title: Re-login account
relogin.description: Update credentials for an expired account without affecting others.

challenge_channel.title: Choose verification method
challenge_channel.description: This Huawei account needs a verification code. Choose how to receive it: **SMS** sends the code to the phone bound to the account; **Signed-in device** requires you to read it on a Huawei device already signed in to this account.

acct_challenge_channel.title: Choose verification method
acct_challenge_channel.description: This Huawei account needs a verification code. Choose how to receive it: **SMS** sends the code to the phone bound to the account; **Signed-in device** requires you to read it on a Huawei device already signed in to this account.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Huawei Cloud, check your network and retry.
error.invalid_challenge: Incorrect or expired verification code, please retry.
error.authorization_pending: Authorization not detected yet. Confirm in the browser, then submit again.
error.code_expired: The verification code expired. A new one has been generated, please authorize again.
error.no_device: No Home Storage device found in this account.
error.code_dispatch_failed: Could not send the verification code. Try again or pick another method.

abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Huawei Cloud or obtain device credentials.
abort.no_device: No Home Storage device found in this account.
abort.already_configured: This device is already configured for this Huawei account. To access the same device with another account, add it again with that account.
abort.smarthome_unavailable: Account login module unavailable; use device-code authorization instead.
abort.cannot_remove_last: At least one account must remain.

init.title: Account management
init.description: {accounts} account(s) connected: {list}. Device attributes (disk, online, file space) come from the admin account; album stats differ per account.

host.title: Device IP

options.account: Huawei account + password (no browser hop, recommended)
options.device_code: Device code (confirm once in a browser, HA never sees the password)

refresh_credentials.name: Refresh device credentials
refresh_credentials.description: Request a new device session from Huawei Cloud (use when the device returns 401 or credentials expire).

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Leave empty to target the first configured device.

duplicate_scan.name: Duplicate photo scan
duplicate_scan.description: Start or stop duplicate photo scan (never deletes photos).

delete_media.name: Move media to trash
delete_media.description: Move photos/videos to the recycle bin (recoverable).

recover_media.name: Recover media
recover_media.description: Restore photos/videos from the recycle bin.
